name: Kasmina
description: Kasmina is a secretive planeswalker who has worked behind the scenes across planes to avert apocalypse, and who brought the Kenrith twins to Strixhaven.

description_citations.text: "Kasmina". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Kasmina is a secretive planeswalker who has worked behind the scenes across planes to avert apocalypse, and who brought the Kenrith twins to Strixhaven.

citations.text: "Kasmina". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: In the War of the Spark she joined Huatli and Saheeli Rai in the storming of a hill.

citations.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

bio.text: Soon after Garruk left the Kenrith twins on their own, she invited them to Arcavios, greeted them with her owl and guided them to Strixhaven.

citations.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.
"Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

status.text: As of the latest mention, Kasmina is a former professor whose name is whispered with dread on the Strixhaven campus after an incident.

citations.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citations.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Gruul, Simic and Izzet storm a hill together, and Huatli, Saheeli Rai and Kasmina join; Bombop and a Simic shaman are killed.
timeline.quote: Poor Bombop rushed in too far ahead of the rest of us.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Will recalls that Kasmina's invitation came soon after Garruk left them on their own.
timeline.quote: her invitation had come out of nowhere, arriving only a few days after Garruk had been satisfied enough in their security to leave them on their own

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: The twins arrive on Arcavios where Kasmina and her owl greet them.
timeline.quote: I see you've both made it.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: They pass a huge silver torch on the road to the school.
timeline.quote: The silver column rose high above the trees, piercing the brilliant blue sky.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina welcomes them to Strixhaven as they crest a ridge over the campus.
timeline.quote: Welcome to Strixhaven.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina leaves them at the gates, telling them to find Mavinda Sharpbeak.
timeline.quote: Look for an owlin called Mavinda Sharpbeak.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina watches the twins through her owl's eyes.
timeline.quote: She could still see the twins in her mind, their images a bit warped from the shape of those avian eyes.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina watches Rowan practice lightning through her owl.
timeline.quote: Below, she could see the Kenrith girl sending forked lightning across the lawn.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina's owl sees a masked Oriq agent offer Lukka a silver skull mask, which he refuses.
timeline.quote: It was a silver mask, shaped like a human skull.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina confronts Lukka at the edge of the courtyard and he refuses to be anyone's pawn.
timeline.quote: It's a shame to see a man like you fallen so far.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina and Lukka fight with wind and blade.
timeline.quote: Kasmina sent a scythe of pressurized air straight at Lukka's chest.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina warns Lukka that Extus fights only for himself.
timeline.quote: Do you think Extus is going to change all that?

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina pins Lukka with her staff and demands he yield.
timeline.quote: Before he could get up, Kasmina was there, the point of her staff held just under his chin.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: A swarm of mage hunters approaches the school, and Lukka says they are just getting started.
timeline.quote: a swarm of chitinous, chittering forms scurried between the trees

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina flees in a cloud of white feathers.
timeline.quote: a cloud of white feathers whipped over her, and she was gone

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina surveys the restored campus and the memorial statue.
timeline.quote: The damage from the attack was all but erased; cobbles replaced, hedges regrown.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina sees Lukka wandering with Mila and remaining Oriq, but turns her attention to the twins.
timeline.quote: But he was no longer worth watching.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina reports that Quint vanished in a burst of light, and Liliana wonders if he sparked.
timeline.quote: If Quint's spark ignited, he could still be alive

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Jadzi tells Fel that Professor Vess is missing and that another incident after Kasmina's could cause a stir.
timeline.quote: No one knows where she is,

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.quote: Alandra was recruited for Strixhaven by Professor Kasmina

timeline.quote: This plot was thwarted by the five students combining their powers

citation.text: "Alandra", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Arcavios", section "Omenpaths". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kasmina secretly works to create tensions among the classmates.
timeline.quote: Professor Kasmina endeavored to create tensions between the classmates.

citation.text: "Eula Blue", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kasmina's plot to force the students to ignite and steal their sparks is thwarted; she presumably dies in a snarl.
timeline.quote: Kasmina presumably died in the final confrontation in the heart of a snarl

citation.text: "Eula Blue", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kasmina recruits Jamira as an ember; Jamira begs her to remove her spark.
timeline.quote: Afraid, she begged the Professor to remove her spark if possible

citation.text: "Jamira", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kasmina manipulates Jamira into work with the Preservation Society and abducting Orestes.
timeline.quote: She manipulated Jamira into work with the Arcavios Preservation Society

citation.text: "Jamira", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The five students combine their powers and thwart Kasmina's plot; Kasmina presumably dies in a snarl.
timeline.quote: This plot was thwarted by the five students combining their powers

citation.text: "Jamira", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kasmina is lured to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon and trapped there by Bolas's Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: Kasmina was lured to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon

citation.text: "Kasmina", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kasmina fights the Eternals of the Dreadhorde, pulling one to her side with control magic.
timeline.quote: The skillful use of control magic allowed Kasmina to temporarily pull an Eternal to her side

citation.text: "Kasmina", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kasmina invites Rowan and Will Kenrith to study at Strixhaven and guides them to campus.
timeline.quote: Kasmina went to Kylem and invited Rowan and Will Kenrith to study at Strixhaven

citation.text: "Kasmina", section "Strixhaven". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kasmina confronts Lukka, who realizes she was spying; she wins their battle but retreats when mage hunters arrive.
timeline.quote: Kasmina winning but being forced to retreat once swarms of mage hunters arrived

citation.text: "Kasmina", section "Strixhaven". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kasmina loses her spark in the Desparkening, joins the faculty fully and befriends Liliana Vess.
timeline.quote: losing her Planeswalker's spark in the Desparkening

citation.text: "Kasmina", section "Strixhaven". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kasmina identifies her first five recruits as embers and, with Professor Vess, distributes them among the colleges.
timeline.quote: In consultation with Professor Vess

citation.text: "Kasmina", section "Omens of Chaos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The students notice Kasmina's owls following them; her plan is revealed to force their sparks to ignite and steal them to reignite her own.
timeline.quote: Her underlying purpose was to force them to ignite under stressful circumstances, and to rob their sparks to reignite her own.

citation.text: "Kasmina", section "Omens of Chaos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The students thwart the plot and Kasmina presumably dies in the final confrontation in the heart of a snarl.
timeline.quote: This plot was thwarted by the students working together, and Kasmina presumably died in the final confrontation

citation.text: "Kasmina", section "Omens of Chaos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: For years Kasmina has worked behind the scenes, influencing events across countless planes in hopes of averting apocalypse.
timeline.quote: For years she has worked behind the scenes, influencing events across countless planes in hopes of averting apocalypse.

citation.text: "Kasmina". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Liliana loses her ability to planeswalk in the Desparkening.
timeline.quote: As a result of the Desparkening , she lost her ability to planeswalk.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Post-Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana prevents Kasmina from sacrificing the students.
timeline.quote: Liliana prevented Kasmina from sacrificing the students and the plane to regain her spark

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Post-Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lukka helps the Oriq by distracting Kasmina and coordinating an attack on Strixhaven, then leaves when the Founder Dragons turn the tide.
timeline.quote: when the tide was turned by the Founder Dragons , Lukka quickly left the battlefield

citation.text: "Lukka", section "Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.quote: The siblings were invited to join Strixhaven as students by Kasmina .

citation.text: "Rowan Kenrith", section "Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
